0022600180.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-3) in the Thunder's eighth game of the season, with Oklahoma City sitting 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West, riding a W1 streak and a 5-2 last ten, while Cleveland is 2nd in the Central, 2 games back, 4th in the East, and coming off an L1 streak. The Thunder are missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and the Cavaliers are without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness). Oklahoma City leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 and won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 117-112 win in Cleveland on November 2 in their last meeting.
